title: Bake and Shark
subtitle: Trinidadian fried flatbread with spiced fish
excerpt: Bake and shark is the most famous street food of Trinidad -- fried flatbread split open and filled with seasoned fried fish, tamarind sauce, mango chutney, and salad. It is sold on Maracas Beach and at food stalls across the island. The bread puffs up in the oil and is the perfect vehicle for the filling.
sourceNotes: Bake and shark is the iconic street food of Maracas Bay beach in Trinidad. Shark has been the traditional fish since the 1970s when it was plentiful in Trinidadian waters. Today shark is often replaced with other firm white fish due to concerns over sustainability. The bake -- a fried flatbread -- is the distinctive element.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The bread dough can be made 2 hours ahead. Fry the fish and bread just before serving.

content.text: The bake dough should be soft but not sticky. Use just enough water to bring it together. Let it rest for 30 minutes before rolling -- this relaxes the gluten and makes it easier to shape. The bread should puff up in the oil within seconds of going in.

items.prepNote: use shark fillet if available; otherwise cod or any firm white fish

content.text: Make the bake: mix the flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the milk gradually and mix to a soft dough. Rest for 30 minutes.
Season the fish with garlic paste, spring onion, shallots, chilli, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt. Toss to coat.
Divide the bake dough into 4 balls. Flatten each into a round about 1cm thick.
Heat the oil to 180 degrees in a deep pan. Fry the bread rounds for 2 minutes per side until puffed and golden. Drain and keep warm.
Dredge the seasoned fish in a little flour. Fry in the same oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Drain.
Split the bake open. Fill with pieces of fried fish. Add mayonnaise, mango chutney, and any other toppings you like. Serve immediately.

items.symptom: Bake is not puffing in the oil
items.cause: Oil is not hot enough or the dough was not rested
items.fix: Make sure the oil is at 180 degrees; the bake should begin to puff within 30 seconds of entering the oil

items.symptom: Bread is dense and doughy inside
items.cause: Dough too thick or not enough baking powder
items.fix: Roll to 1cm thickness only; any thicker and the inside will not cook through
Fry fish in smaller batches and allow the oil to come back up to temperature between batches

content.text: Bake and shark is synonymous with Maracas Bay beach in Trinidad. On Sundays and holidays, vendors set up stalls along the beach road and queues form for the fried fish sandwiches. The experience of eating bake and shark with the sea visible and the smell of frying oil in the air is as important as the food itself.
